data.title: Hua Kai Zhang Meili
data.synopsis:
The innocent young girl Zhang Meili, through a series of unexpected events, transfers to Huaxia Global Universe Grand High School. Here, she encounters all sorts of wealthy, handsome, gentle, warm-hearted, domineering CEOs, and her destined prince, but also experiences betrayal. How will the kind-hearted Zhang Meili cope? Meanwhile, her mysterious past is slowly being revealed.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Sekigahara Gassen: Kiro ni Tatta Tarui no Bushou-tachi
data.title_japanese: 関ヶ原合戦 岐路に立った垂井の武将たち
title_synonyms: The Battle of Sekigahara: The Warriors of Tarui Who Stood At the Crossroad
data.synopsis:
The anime short depicts the feelings of two warlords, Takenaka Shigekado and Tamehiro Hiratsuka, who were both comrades in the service of the Toyotomi family but became enemies during the Battle of Sekigahara. The anime focuses on the relationship the two men had with the famous military strategist Takenaka Shigeharu, who served as the advisor for Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

(Source: ANN)
